messages:
Alice B: heads-up — onboarding QuantifyLabs' LoRA adapter into our int4 path. hitting intermittent decimal-truncation on receipt-like generations (cents gone). minimal repro below.
Tom K: can you paste a failing prompt?
Alice B: `Receipt: Order #QF-77 total: $1,299.99 ->` sometimes the model emits `Receipt: Order #QF-77 total: $1,299.` then stops (missing .99). more frequent for ctx >= 2048 and batch_size>1.
Lin Z: interesting. first checks: tokenizer mapping, LoRA merge path, and folded-weight stats. any NaNs/inf?
Alice B: quick smoke: no NaNs. ran a tiny quickpack vs fp16 baseline: cents-preserved metric down ~7% on int4; throughput +20%.
Maya P: please run focused quickpack with debug flags: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model quantifylabs/lora --quant int4 --suite numeric --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --dump-weight-stats --dump-logits --kv-warmup 2` and also `--disable-fused-gemm` variant.
Tom K: try greedy decode and `--temp=0` too. if greedy still drops cents it's deterministic in quant path. also `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` helps isolate kernel issues.
Lin Z: add `--dump-folded-weights` and run `RUNNER_DEBUG=quant,kernels` to get per-kernel outputs. suspect missing clamp/bias compensation when folding LoRA into int4 scale.
Alice B: kicked CI: ci/quantify-int4-210 by @Alice B (inference-eval:canary).
ci-bot: job/210 started — runner: inference-eval:canary
Alice B: logs snippet: ```
[prompt] Receipt: Order #QF-77 total: $1,299.99 ->
[tokenizer] ids: [120, 32, 77, 400, 56, 999, ...]
[emit] "Receipt: Order #QF-77 total: $1,299."
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[logits] last_layer_mean: 0.0016 -> 0.00011 (failing case)
```
Maya P: eos short + collapsed logits = quant-scale mismatch. fp16 baseline?
Alice B: fp16 is clean. only int4 affected.
Tom K: run `--dump-attn-step 8-14` to see if last-layer activations collapse. also compare folded vs unfolded weight min/max.
Lin Z: if clamp is missing, LoRA delta may push some logits under quant resolution causing digits to lose probability mass. patch idea: add tiny per-tensor clamp after folding and a post-fold calibration pass (re-run a few calibration prompts).
Maya P: mitigation plan: 1) add clamp+calibration patch in quantizer; 2) unit test folding+greedy-decode on 50 invoice prompts (fail if cents missing); 3) customer quickpack with notebook and run commands so QuantifyLabs can verify on their infra; 4) rollout canary int4 at 3% with auto-fallback to fp16 for tenants where `cents-preserved < baseline - 3%`.
Alice B: uploaded traces and quickpack: s3://redwood-evals/quantify/210/artifacts.tar.gz (notebook + 30 receipt prompts + logs).
ci-bot: job/210 completed: SUCCESS (artifacts uploaded)

Tom K: I'll open a PR with clamp+unit test. also let's add a runtime metric alert: if `numeric-cents-preserved` drops >2% in the canary window, trigger immediate routing to fp16 for that tenant.
Lin Z: also add an Optimize rule: mark invoice/receipt workloads as "int4-sensitive" recommending fp16 or safe-quant preset for money tokens.
Alice B: thanks all — posting PR link and canary plan once PR lands. will share customer-facing quickpack link with QuantifyLabs support. :thumbsup:
